{"content": "\"\"\"\n操作日志中间件 — 自动记录 API 操作\n\n记录规则：\n- 所有 POST/PUT/DELETE 操作自动记录\n- GET 请求仅记录 search/export/download 类\n- 日志异步写入，不阻塞请求\n\"\"\"\n\nimport time\nimport threading\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware\nfrom starlette.responses import Response\n\nfrom app.core.database import SessionLocal\nfrom app.models.models import OperationLog\n\n# 需要记录的 GET 操作前缀\n_LOG_GET_PREFIXES = (\"/api/search/\", \"/api/log/\", \"/api/stats/\")\n\n# 操作类型映射\n_OP_MAP = {\n    \"login\": \"login\", \"logout\": \"logout\",\n    \"search\": \"search\", \"export\": \"export\",\n    \"ocr\": \"ocr\", \"review\": \"review\",\n    \"user\": \"admin\", \"sync\": \"admin\", \"log\": \"admin\",\n    \"auth\": \"login\",\n}\n\n\ndef _write_log_sync(\n    user_id: int, username: str, op_type: str, module: str,\n    description: str, target_id: str, ip: str, result: str,\n):\n    \"\"\"同步写日志（在独立线程中执行）\"\"\"\n    db = SessionLocal()\n    try:\n        log = OperationLog(\n            user_id=user_id,\n            username=username,\n            operation_type=op_type,\n            module=module,\n            description=description,\n            target_id=target_id,\n            ip_address=ip,\n            result=result,\n        )\n        db.add(log)\n        db.commit()\n    except Exception:\n        pass  # 日志写入失败不影响业务\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\nclass OperationLogMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):\n    \"\"\"操作日志中间件\"\"\"\n\n    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next) -> Response:\n        t0 = time.time()\n        response = await call_next(request)\n        duration_ms = round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)\n\n        # 确定是否需要记录\n        method = request.method\n        path = request.url.path\n\n        if method == \"GET\":\n            if not any(path.startswith(p) for p in _LOG_GET_PREFIXES):\n                return response\n            op_tag = \"search\" if \"/search/\" in path else \"log\"\n        elif method in (\"POST\", \"PUT\", \"DELETE\"):\n            op_tag = path.split(\"/\")[2] if len(path.split(\"/\")) > 2 else \"other\"\n        else:\n            return response\n\n        # 提取用户信息\n        user_id = 0\n        username = \"anonymous\"\n        try:\n            token = request.headers.get(\"Authorization\", \"\")\n            if token.startswith(\"Bearer \"):\n                from app.core.security import decode_access_token\n                payload = decode_access_token(token[7:])\n                if payload:\n                    user_id = int(payload.get(\"sub\", 0))\n                    username = payload.get(\"username\", \"anonymous\")\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n        op_type = _OP_MAP.get(op_tag, op_tag)\n        result = \"success\" if response.status_code < 400 else \"failure\"\n\n        description = f\"{method} {path}\"\n        if method == \"POST\" and \"/api/search/\" in path:\n            description = f\"检索操作 (耗时 {duration_ms}ms)\"\n\n        # 异步写日志\n        ip = request.client.host if request.client else \"\"\n        threading.Thread(\n            target=_write_log_sync,\n            args=(user_id, username, op_type, op_tag, description, \"\", ip, result),\n            daemon=True,\n        ).start()\n\n        return response\n", "path": "archive-system/backend/app/middleware/log_middleware.py"}

"""FastAPI 主入口"""

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import engine, Base, init_db
from app.api import search, ocr, review, sync, auth, user, log, stats


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """应用生命周期"""
    # 启动时 — SQLite 模式自动建表
    if settings.DB_MODE == "sqlite":
        init_db()
    yield
    # 关闭时
    engine.dispose()


app = FastAPI(
    title=settings.APP_NAME,
    version=settings.APP_VERSION,
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

# ===================== CORS =====================
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["http://localhost:3000", "http://localhost:5173"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# ===================== 注册路由 =====================
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["认证"])
app.include_router(search.router, prefix="/api/search", tags=["智能检索"])
app.include_router(ocr.router, prefix="/api/ocr", tags=["OCR识别"])
app.include_router(review.router, prefix="/api/review", tags=["AI开放预审"])
app.include_router(sync.router, prefix="/api/sync", tags=["数据同步"])
app.include_router(user.router, prefix="/api/user", tags=["用户管理"])
app.include_router(log.router, prefix="/api/log", tags=["操作日志"])
app.include_router(stats.router, prefix="/api/stats", tags=["查询统计"])


@app.get("/api/health")
def health_check():
    es_ok = False
    try:
        from app.core.database import get_es
        es = get_es()
        es_ok = es is not None and es.ping()
    except Exception:
        pass

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "app": settings.APP_NAME,
        "version": settings.APP_VERSION,
        "db_mode": settings.DB_MODE,
        "llm_mode": settings.LLM_MODE,
        "ocr_mode": settings.OCR_MODE,
        "es_available": es_ok,
    }

查询待处理档案\n        q = db.query(Archive).filter(Archive.ocr_status.in_([\"pending\", \"failed\"]))\n        if criteria.get(\"year_from\"):\n            q = q.filter(Archive.year >= criteria[\"year_from\"])\n        if criteria.get(\"year_to\"):\n            q = q.filter(Archive.year <= criteria[\"year_to\"])\n        if criteria.get(\"category\"):\n            q = q.filter(Archive.category == criteria[\"category\"])\n\n        archives = q.all()\n        total = len(archives)\n\n        task.status = \"running\"\n        task.total_pages = total\n        task.processed_pages = 0\n        db.commit()\n\n        for i, archive in enumerate(archives):\n            try:\n                img_path = _find_image(archive.archive_id)\n                if not img_path:\n                    archive.ocr_status = \"failed\"\n                    db.commit()\n                    continue\n\n                result = ocr_client.recognize(img_path)\n\n                archive.ocr_text = result.get(\"text\", \"\")\n                archive.ocr_confidence = result.get(\"confidence\", 0)\n                archive.ocr_status = \"done\" if result.get(\"confidence\", 0) >= 0.7 else \"low_quality\"\n                task.processed_pages = i + 1\n                db.commit()\n\n                # 增量更新 ES 索引\n                _update_es_index(archive)\n\n            except Exception as e:\n                logger.error(f\"OCR failed for {archive.archive_id}: {e}\")\n                archive.ocr_status = \"failed\"\n                task.processed_pages = i + 1\n                db.commit()\n\n        task.status = \"completed\"\n        db.commit()\n\n    except Exception as exc:\n        task = db.query(OcrTask).filter(OcrTask.id == task_id).first()\n        if task:\n            task.status = \"failed\"\n            db.commit()\n        raise self.retry(exc=exc)\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n    return {\"task_id\": task_id, \"processed\": task.processed_pages}\n\n\n@celery_app.task(bind=True, max_retries=2)\ndef process_single_ocr(self, archive_id: str, image_path: str):\n    \"\"\"单条 OCR 处理\"\"\"\n    db = SessionLocal()\n    try:\n        result = ocr_client.recognize(image_path)\n        archive = db.query(Archive).filter(Archive.archive_id == archive_id).first()\n        if archive:\n            archive.ocr_text = result.get(\"text\", \"\")\n            archive.ocr_confidence = result.get(\"confidence\", 0)\n            archive.ocr_status = \"done\"\n            db.commit()\n            _update_es_index(archive)\n        return result\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\ndef _find_image(archive_id: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"根据档案编号查找图像路径\"\"\"\n    from app.core.config import settings\n    import os\n\n    sync_dir = settings.SYNC_DATA_DIR\n    # 按 \"年度-门类-案卷号\" 结构检索\n    parts = archive_id.split(\"-\")\n    for year_dir in [parts[0]] if parts else []:\n        year_path = os.path.join(sync_dir, year_dir)\n        if not os.path.isdir(year_path):\n            continue\n        for root, _, files in os.walk(year_path):\n            for f in files:\n                if archive_id in f and f.lower().endswith((\".tiff\", \".tif\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\", \".png\", \".pdf\")):\n                    return os.path.join(root, f)\n    return None\n\n\ndef _update_es_index(archive: Archive):\n    \"\"\"增量更新 ES 全文索引\"\"\"\n    es = get_es()\n    if es is None:\n        return\n    from app.core.config import settings\n\n    doc = {\n        \"archive_id\": archive.archive_id,\n        \"title\": archive.title,\n        \"full_text\": archive.ocr_text or \"\",\n        \"year\": archive.year,\n        \"category\": archive.category,\n        \"department\": archive.department,\n        \"fonds_id\": archive.fonds_id,\n        \"retention_period\": archive.retention_period,\n        \"security_level\": archive.security_level,\n        \"open_status\": \"未审核\",\n        \"ocr_confidence\": archive.ocr_confidence,\n        \"ocr_text_quality\": archive.ocr_status,\n        \"file_count\": archive.file_count,\n    }\n    try:\n        index = f\"{settings.ES_INDEX_PREFIX}_fulltext\"\n        es.index(index=index, id=archive.archive_id, body=doc, refresh=\"wait_for\")\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n", "path": "archive-system/backend/app/tasks/ocr_tasks.py"}

{"content": "\"\"\"\n档案图像预处理管线\n\n处理目标：\n- 泛黄纸张增强对比度\n- 去噪（扫描底纹、椒盐噪声）\n- 倾斜校正\n- 自适应二值化\n- 可选超分辨率（低分辨率模糊名册）\n\n用法:\n  python train/ocr/preprocess.py --input data/raw/ --output data/processed/\n\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ntry:\n    import cv2\n    import numpy as np\nexcept ImportError:\n    print(\"请安装 opencv-python: pip install opencv-python numpy\")\n    sys.exit(1)\n\n\ndef preprocess_archive(\n    img_path: str,\n    do_denoise: bool = True,\n    do_clahe: bool = True,\n    do_deskew: bool = True,\n    do_binarize: bool = True,\n    target_dpi: int = 300,\n) -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"完整的档案图像预处理\"\"\"\n    img = cv2.imread(img_path)\n    if img is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"无法读取图像: {img_path}\")\n\n    # 1. 灰度化\n    if len(img.shape) == 3:\n        gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)\n    else:\n        gray = img\n\n    # 2. 去噪 — 针对档案扫描的底纹噪声\n    if do_denoise:\n        gray = cv2.fastNlMeansDenoising(gray, h=10, templateWindowSize=7, searchWindowSize=21)\n\n    # 3. CLAHE 自适应对比度增强 — 解决泛黄/褪色\n    if do_clahe:\n        clahe = cv2.createCLAHE(clipLimit=2.0, tileGridSize=(8, 8))\n        gray = clahe.apply(gray)\n\n    # 4. 倾斜校正\n    if do_deskew:\n        gray = _deskew(gray)\n\n    # 5. 自适应二值化\n    if do_binarize:\n        gray = cv2.adaptiveThreshold(\n            gray, 255, cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C,\n            cv2.THRESH_BINARY, 11, 2,\n        )\n\n    return gray\n\n\ndef _deskew(gray: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"基于文本行的倾斜校正\"\"\"\n    # 二值化\n    _, binary = cv2.threshold(gray, 0, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV + cv2.THRESH_OTSU)\n\n    # 找所有非零像素坐标\n    coords = np.column_stack(np.where(binary > 0))\n    if len(coords) < 100:\n        return gray  # 太少的像素，跳过\n\n    # 最小外接矩形 → 角度\n    rect = cv2.minAreaRect(coords.astype(np.float32))\n    angle = rect[-1]\n\n    # 调整角度范围\n    if angle < -45:\n        angle = 90 + angle\n    if abs(angle) < 0.3:\n        return gray  # 角度太小，不校正\n\n    h, w = gray.shape\n    center = (w // 2, h // 2)\n    M = cv2.getRotationMatrix2D(center, angle, 1.0)\n    rotated = cv2.warpAffine(gray, M, (w, h), borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REPLICATE)\n    return rotated\n\n\ndef batch_preprocess(\n    input_dir: str,\n    output_dir: str,\n    extensions: tuple = (\".jpg\", \".jpeg\", \".png\", \".tiff\", \".tif\", \".bmp\"),\n) -> int:\n    \"\"\"批量预处理\"\"\"\n    input_path = Path(input_dir)\n    output_path = Path(output_dir)\n    output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    count = 0\n    image_files = [f for f in input_path.rglob(\"*\") if f.suffix.lower() in extensions]\n\n    print(f\"📂 找到 {len(image_files)} 个图像文件\")\n\n    for img_file in image_files:\n        try:\n            processed = preprocess_archive(str(img_file))\n\n            # 保持相对路径结构\n            rel_path = img_file.relative_to(input_path)\n            out_file = output_path / rel_path.with_suffix(\".png\")\n            out_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n            cv2.imwrite(str(out_file), processed)\n            count += 1\n\n            if count % 50 == 0:\n                print(f\"  ⏳ 已处理 {count}/{len(image_files)}\")\n\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"  ❌ {img_file.name}: {e}\")\n\n    print(f\"✅ 完成: {count} 个文件 → {output_dir}\")\n    return count\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"档案图像预处理\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--input\", \"-i\", required=True, help=\"原始图像目录\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output\", \"-o\", required=True, help=\"输出目录\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--no-denoise\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--no-clahe\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--no-deskew\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--no-binarize\", action=\"store_true\")\n\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    # 单文件演示模式\n    input_path = Path(args.input)\n    if input_path.is_file():\n        out_file = Path(args.output) / f\"processed_{input_path.name}\"\n        out_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        processed = preprocess_archive(\n            str(input_path),\n            do_denoise=not args.no_denoise,\n            do_clahe=not args.no_clahe,\n            do_deskew=not args.no_deskew,\n            do_binarize=not args.no_binarize,\n        )\n        cv2.imwrite(str(out_file), processed)\n        print(f\"✅ 单文件处理完成: {out_file}\")\n        print(f\"   原始/处理后: {input_path} → {out_file}\")\n        return\n\n    batch_preprocess(args.input, args.output)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n", "path": "archive-system/train/ocr/preprocess.py"}

{results['edit_distance_norm']:.4f}\")\n    print(f\"  低置信度样本:   {len(results['low_confidence'])}\")\n    print()\n\n    # 目标对比\n    targets = {\"印刷体\": 0.99, \"手写体\": 0.85, \"表格\": 0.90, \"混合排版\": {"content": "\"\"\"\nLLaMA-Factory API 验证脚本\n\n验证王华哲老师部署的 LLaMA-Factory 实例是否可用：\n  地址: http://10.11.13.100:7860/\n\n用法:\n  python train/llm/verify_llamafactory.py\n\"\"\"\n\nimport requests\nimport json\nimport sys\nimport time\n\nBASE_URL = \"http://10.11.13.100:7860\"\n\nCHECKS = [\n    {\n        \"name\": \"Web UI 主页\",\n        \"method\": \"GET\",\n        \"path\": \"/\",\n        \"expect_status\": 200,\n        \"expect_text\": \"LLaMA\",\n    },\n    {\n        \"name\": \"API 文档\",\n        \"method\": \"GET\",\n        \"path\": \"/docs\",\n        \"expect_status\": 200,\n    },\n    {\n        \"name\": \"模型列表\",\n        \"method\": \"GET\",\n        \"path\": \"/api/models\",\n        \"expect_status\": 200,\n    },\n    {\n        \"name\": \"训练参数获取\",\n        \"method\": \"GET\",\n        \"path\": \"/api/train_args\",\n        \"expect_status\": 200,\n    },\n]\n\n\ndef check_server() -> dict:\n    \"\"\"检查 LLaMA-Factory 服务器\"\"\"\n    results = {\"url\": BASE_URL, \"checks\": [], \"available\": False, \"models\": [], \"issues\": []}\n\n    session = requests.Session()\n    session.timeout = 10\n\n    # 1. 基本连通性\n    try:\n        resp = session.get(f\"{BASE_URL}/\", timeout=5)\n        results[\"available\"] = True\n    except requests.ConnectionError:\n        results[\"issues\"].append(f\"无法连接 {BASE_URL} — 请确认网络/VPN 已连接\")\n        return results\n    except requests.Timeout:\n        results[\"issues\"].append(f\"连接 {BASE_URL} 超时\")\n        return results\n\n    # 2. 各项检查\n    for check in CHECKS:\n        try:\n            if check[\"method\"] == \"GET\":\n                resp = session.get(f\"{BASE_URL}{check['path']}\")\n            else:\n                resp = session.post(f\"{BASE_URL}{check['path']}\")\n\n            ok = resp.status_code == check[\"expect_status\"]\n            detail = f\"HTTP {resp.status_code}\"\n\n            # 检查响应内容\n            if \"expect_text\" in check and ok:\n                if check[\"expect_text\"] not in resp.text:\n                    ok = False\n                    detail += f\" (内容不包含 '{check['expect_text']}')\"\n\n            results[\"checks\"].append({\n                \"name\": check[\"name\"],\n                \"ok\": ok,\n                \"detail\": detail,\n            })\n\n            # 模型列表特殊处理\n            if check[\"name\"] == \"模型列表\" and ok:\n                try:\n                    models = resp.json()\n                    results[\"models\"] = [m.get(\"name\", str(m)) for m in models] if isinstance(models, list) else [str(models)]\n                except:\n                    results[\"models\"] = [\"(无法解析)\"]\n\n        except Exception as e:\n            results[\"checks\"].append({\n                \"name\": check[\"name\"],\n                \"ok\": False,\n                \"detail\": str(e),\n            })\n\n    return results\n\n\ndef print_report(results: dict):\n    \"\"\"打印检查报告\"\"\"\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n    print(\"  LLaMA-Factory 服务器验证\")\n    print(f\"  地址: {results['url']}\")\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n\n    if not results[\"available\"]:\n        print(\"  ❌ 服务器不可达\")\n        for issue in results[\"issues\"]:\n            print(f\"     → {issue}\")\n        print()\n        print(\"  可能原因:\")\n        print(\"  1. 校园 VPN 未连接 (服务器在内网)\")\n        print(\"  2. 服务器未开机\")\n        print(\"  3. LLaMA-Factory 服务未启动\")\n        return\n\n    print(\"  ✅ 服务器可达\\n\")\n\n    all_ok = True\n    for check in results[\"checks\"]:\n        icon = \"✅\" if check[\"ok\"] else \"❌\"\n        print(f\"  {icon} {check['name']}: {check['detail']}\")\n        if not check[\"ok\"]:\n            all_ok = False\n\n    if results[\"models\"]:\n        print(f\"\\n  📦 可用模型 ({len(results['models'])} 个):\")\n        for m in results[\"models\"]:\n            print(f\"     • {m}\")\n\n    print()\n    if all_ok:\n        print(\"  🎉 所有检查通过！LLaMA-Factory 就绪，可以开始微调。\")\n        print()\n        print(\"  下一步:\")\n        print(\"  1. 上传训练数据: train/data/review_sft.json\")\n        print(\"  2. 在 Web UI 中注册数据集: archive_review\")\n        print(\"  3. 使用 train/llm/configs/lora_train.yaml 开始训练\")\n    else:\n        print(\"  ⚠️ 部分检查未通过，请确认:\")\n        print(\"  1. LLaMA-Factory 是否为完整安装 (非仅 demo)\")\n        print(\"  2. 模型文件是否已下载到服务器\")\n        print(\"  3. 版本是否为最新 (支持 LoRA + Qwen)\")\n\n\ndef test_inference():\n    \"\"\"测试推理 API — 发送一条审核请求\"\"\"\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n    print(\"  推理 API 测试\")\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n\n    test_text = \"\"\"关于一九九六年招生工作的总结报告\n    \n本年度招生工作在校党委的领导下顺利完成。共录取本科生1200人，研究生300人。\n具体工作包括：制定招生计划、组织考试、录取审核等环节。\n    \n存在问题：部分专业报考人数不足，需进一步优化专业设置。\"\"\"\n\n    payload = {\n        \"model\": \"qwen\",\n        \"messages\": [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": \"你是档案开放审核专家。\"},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": f\"审核以下档案：\\n{test_text}\"},\n        ],\n        \"temperature\": 0.1,\n        \"max_tokens\": 512,\n    }\n\n    try:\n        resp = requests.post(\n            f\"{BASE_URL}/api/chat\",\n            json=payload,\n            timeout=30,\n        )\n        if resp.status_code == 200:\n            data = resp.json()\n            print(\"  ✅ 推理 API 可用\")\n            print(f\"  响应: {json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)[:500]}\")\n        else:\n            print(f\"  ⚠️ 推理 API 返回 HTTP {resp.status_code}\")\n            print(f\"  {resp.text[:300]}\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  ❌ 推理 API 调用失败: {e}\")\n        print(\"  (可能模型未加载或 API 路径不同)\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    results = check_server()\n    print_report(results)\n\n    if results[\"available\"]:\n        print()\n        test_inference()\n", "path": "archive-system/train/llm/verify_llamafactory.py"}

"""LLM Mock 客户端 — 开发环境返回模拟审核结果"""

import os
import random
import hashlib
from typing import Optional

from app.core.config import settings


# 模拟敏感词列表（脱敏版，仅用于开发测试）
_MOCK_SENSITIVE_WORDS = [
    "个人隐私", "身份证号", "家庭出身", "健康信息",
    "上级来文", "外收文", "内部文件", "会议纪要(密)",
    "知识产权", "专利", "版权",
]

_MOCK_RISK_REASONS = {
    "low": "该档案为常规行政管理文件，不涉及国家秘密、商业秘密或个人隐私，建议开放。",
    "medium": "档案包含部分内部管理信息，建议人工复核后决定。",
    "high": "档案涉及上级来文引用及个人敏感信息，建议延期开放或不予开放。",
}


class LLMClient:
    """LLM 审核客户端 — mock 模式用于开发，real 模式调用昇腾推理"""

    def __init__(self):
        self.mode = settings.LLM_MODE

    def review(self, full_text: str, metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        if self.mode == "mock":
            return self._mock_review(full_text, metadata)
        else:
            return self._real_review(full_text, metadata)

    def _mock_review(self, full_text: str, metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        """模拟审核：基于文本内容中的关键词生成假结果"""
        # 用文本哈希生成确定性随机，同一个文本多次调用结果一致
        seed = int(hashlib.md5(full_text.encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
        rng = random.Random(seed)

        # 统计命中敏感词（模拟）
        hits = []
        for word in _MOCK_SENSITIVE_WORDS:
            if word in full_text:
                hits.append({
                    "type": word,
                    "content": f"[MOCK] 检测到疑似{word}相关内容",
                    "start_char": full_text.find(word) if word in full_text else -1,
                    "end_char": full_text.find(word) + len(word) if word in full_text else -1,
                })

        # 风险评分
        if not hits:
            risk_score = rng.randint(0, 15)
            risk_level = "低"
            suggestion = "建议开放"
        elif len(hits) <= 2:
            risk_score = rng.randint(20, 55)
            risk_level = "中"
            suggestion = "建议人工重点关注"
        else:
            risk_score = rng.randint(60, 95)
            risk_level = "高"
            suggestion = "建议延期开放或不予开放"

        return {
            "risk_score": risk_score,
            "risk_level": risk_level,
            "sensitive_items": hits,
            "suggestion": suggestion,
            "reason": _MOCK_RISK_REASONS[{"低": "low", "中": "medium", "高": "high"}[risk_level]],
            "confidence": round(rng.uniform(0.75, 0.98), 2),
        }

    def _real_review(self, full_text: str, metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        """真实 LLM 推理 — 调用昇腾 NPU 上的模型"""
        # TODO: 替换为 vLLM-ascend / MindIE 调用
        raise NotImplementedError("真实 LLM 推理待 L3 环境配置后实现")

    def understand_query(self, query: str) -> dict:
        """语义检索 — query 理解"""
        if self.mode == "mock":
            return self._mock_understand_query(query)
        else:
            return self._real_understand_query(query)

    def _mock_understand_query(self, query: str) -> dict:
        """模拟 query 理解"""
        return {
            "intent": "keyword_search",
            "entities": [],
            "keywords": query.split(),
            "synonyms": [],
            "time_range": None,
            "suggest_fields": ["title^3", "full_text"],
        }

    def _real_understand_query(self, query: str) -> dict:
        raise NotImplementedError("真实 LLM query 理解待 L3 环境配置后实现")


# 全局单例
llm_client = LLMClient()
```

"""LLM 客户端 — mock 模式返回模拟结果，real 模式调用 LLaMA-Factory API"""

import os
import json
import random
import hashlib
from typing import Optional

import requests

from app.core.config import settings

# Prompt 模板
SYSTEM_REVIEW = """你是中南财经政法大学档案馆的档案开放审核专家。审核档案全文，判断是否可以向社会开放。

审核依据：1.国家秘密(绝密/机密/秘密)→不予开放 2.未结论重大事项→不予开放 3.学校内部事项→不予开放 4.知识产权→不予开放 5.个人隐私(身份证号/家庭出身/成绩/健康)→不予或部分开放 6.上级来文/外收文→不予开放 7.捐献未授权→不予开放

输出 JSON: {"risk_score":0-100,"risk_level":"低|中|高","sensitive_items":[{"type":"...","content":"...","start_char":0,"end_char":0}],"suggestion":"建议开放|建议部分开放|建议延期开放|建议不予开放","reason":"...","confidence":0.0-1.0}
评分：0-20低/21-60中/61-100高。宁可假阳性不可假阴性。不确定时标注低置信度。"""

# LLaMA-Factory API 地址
LLAMAFACTORY_URL = getattr(settings, 'LLAMAFACTORY_URL', 'http://10.11.13.100:7860')


# 模拟敏感词列表（脱敏版，仅用于开发测试）
_MOCK_SENSITIVE_WORDS = [
    "个人隐私", "身份证号", "家庭出身", "健康信息",
    "上级来文", "外收文", "内部文件", "会议纪要(密)",
    "知识产权", "专利", "版权",
]

_MOCK_RISK_REASONS = {
    "low": "该档案为常规行政管理文件，不涉及国家秘密、商业秘密或个人隐私，建议开放。",
    "medium": "档案包含部分内部管理信息，建议人工复核后决定。",
    "high": "档案涉及上级来文引用及个人敏感信息，建议延期开放或不予开放。",
}


class LLMClient:
    """LLM 审核客户端 — mock 模式用于开发，real 模式调用昇腾推理"""

    def __init__(self):
        self.mode = settings.LLM_MODE

    def review(self, full_text: str, metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        if self.mode == "mock":
            return self._mock_review(full_text, metadata)
        else:
            return self._real_review(full_text, metadata)

    def _mock_review(self, full_text: str, metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        """模拟审核：基于文本内容中的关键词生成假结果"""
        # 用文本哈希生成确定性随机，同一个文本多次调用结果一致
        seed = int(hashlib.md5(full_text.encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
        rng = random.Random(seed)

        # 统计命中敏感词（模拟）
        hits = []
        for word in _MOCK_SENSITIVE_WORDS:
            if word in full_text:
                hits.append({
                    "type": word,
                    "content": f"[MOCK] 检测到疑似{word}相关内容",
                    "start_char": full_text.find(word) if word in full_text else -1,
                    "end_char": full_text.find(word) + len(word) if word in full_text else -1,
                })

        # 风险评分
        if not hits:
            risk_score = rng.randint(0, 15)
            risk_level = "低"
            suggestion = "建议开放"
        elif len(hits) <= 2:
            risk_score = rng.randint(20, 55)
            risk_level = "中"
            suggestion = "建议人工重点关注"
        else:
            risk_score = rng.randint(60, 95)
            risk_level = "高"
            suggestion = "建议延期开放或不予开放"

        return {
            "risk_score": risk_score,
            "risk_level": risk_level,
            "sensitive_items": hits,
            "suggestion": suggestion,
            "reason": _MOCK_RISK_REASONS[{"低": "low", "中": "medium", "高": "high"}[risk_level]],
            "confidence": round(rng.uniform(0.75, 0.98), 2),
        }

    def _real_review(self, full_text: str, metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        """真实 LLM 推理 — 调用 LLaMA-Factory API"""
        user_prompt = f"请审核以下档案：\n\n档案编号：{metadata.get('archive_id', '')}\n题名：{metadata.get('title', '')}\n归口单位：{metadata.get('department', '')}\n归档年度：{metadata.get('year', '')}\n\n全文内容：\n{full_text[:3000]}"

        result = self._call_llm(SYSTEM_REVIEW, user_prompt)
        try:
            return json.loads(result)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return {
                "risk_score": 50, "risk_level": "中",
                "sensitive_items": [],
                "suggestion": "建议人工复核",
                "reason": f"LLM 返回非 JSON 格式: {result[:200]}",
                "confidence": 0.5,
            }

    def understand_query(self, query: str) -> dict:
        """语义检索 — query 理解"""
        if self.mode == "mock":
            return self._mock_understand_query(query)
        else:
            return self._real_understand_query(query)

    def _mock_understand_query(self, query: str) -> dict:
        """模拟 query 理解"""
        keywords = query.split()
        entities = []
        time_range = None
        for kw in keywords:
            if kw.isdigit() and len(kw) == 4:
                time_range = [int(kw), int(kw)]
                entities.append({"name": kw, "type": "YEAR"})
        return {
            "intent": "topic_research" if len(keywords) > 2 else "exact_lookup",
            "entities": entities,
            "keywords": keywords,
            "synonyms": [],
            "time_range": time_range,
            "suggest_fields": ["title^3", "full_text"],
        }

    def _real_understand_query(self, query: str) -> dict:
        """真实 query 理解 — 调用 LLaMA-Factory API"""
        system = "你是档案检索意图分析助手。用户输入查询，你输出 JSON: {\"intent\":\"exact_lookup|topic_research|person_lookup|stat_query\",\"entities\":[],\"keywords\":[],\"synonyms\":[],\"time_range\":null,\"suggest_fields\":[\"title^3\",\"full_text\"]}"
        user = f'用户查询："{query}"\n\n仅输出 JSON。'

        result = self._call_llm(system, user)
        try:
            return json.loads(result)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return {
                "intent": "keyword_search", "entities": [], "time_range": None,
                "keywords": query.split(), "synonyms": [],
                "suggest_fields": ["title^3", "full_text"],
            }

    # ==================== 底层 API 调用 ====================

    def _call_llm(self, system: str, user: str, temperature: float = 0.1, max_tokens: int = 1024) -> str:
        """调用 LLaMA-Factory /chat API"""
        try:
            resp = requests.post(
                f"{LLAMAFACTORY_URL}/api/chat",
                json={
                    "messages": [
                        {"role": "system", "content": system},
                        {"role": "user", "content": user},
                    ],
                    "temperature": temperature,
                    "max_tokens": max_tokens,
                },
                timeout=60,
            )
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                data = resp.json()
                return (
                    data.get("choices", [{}])[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "")
                    or data.get("response", "")
                    or str(data)
                )
            return f"HTTP {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:300]}"
        except requests.ConnectionError:
            return '{"risk_score":50,"risk_level":"中","suggestion":"建议人工复核","reason":"LLM 服务不可达","confidence":0.3}'
        except Exception as e:
            return f'{{"risk_score":50,"risk_level":"中","suggestion":"建议人工复核","reason":"{str(e)[:80]}","confidence":0.3}}'


# 全局单例
llm_client = LLMClient()
```

"""OCR 识别 API — 任务管理 + 结果查看 + 质量报告"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional

from app.core.security import get_current_user

router = APIRouter()


class CreateOcrTaskRequest(BaseModel):
    task_name: str
    year_from: Optional[int] = None
    year_to: Optional[int] = None
    category: Optional[str] = None
    department: Optional[str] = None


@router.post("/tasks")
def create_ocr_task(req: CreateOcrTaskRequest, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """创建 OCR 任务"""
    return {"task_id": 1, "task_name": req.task_name, "status": "queued"}


@router.get("/tasks")
def list_ocr_tasks(
    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    status: Optional[str] = None,
):
    """OCR 任务列表"""
    return {"total": 0, "page": page, "page_size": page_size, "items": []}


@router.get("/tasks/{task_id}")
def get_ocr_task(task_id: int, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """OCR 任务详情 + 进度"""
    return {
        "task_id": task_id,
        "status": "pending",
        "total_pages": 0,
        "processed_pages": 0,
        "speed_ppm": 0,
        "estimated_remaining_seconds": 0,
    }


@router.put("/tasks/{task_id}")
def update_ocr_task(task_id: int, action: str, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):

    return {"task_id": task_id, "action": action, "status": "updated"}


@router.get("/results/{archive_id}")
def get_ocr_result(archive_id: str, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):

        "archive_id": archive_id,
        "ocr_text": "",
        "confidence": 0.95,
        "processing_time_ms": 450,
        "engine": "PaddleOCR",
        "model_version": "v1.0",

        "overall_accuracy": 0.93,
        "low_confidence_count": 12,
        "common_errors": [],
    }

"""用户管理 API — CRUD + 角色 + 权限 + 目录树授权"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

from app.core.security import get_current_user, require_role, ROLE_SYSTEM_ADMIN

router = APIRouter()


class CreateUserRequest(BaseModel):
    username: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=50)
    name: str
    department: Optional[str] = None
    contact: Optional[str] = None
    password: str = Field(min_length=12)
    role: str = "reviewer"


class UpdateUserRequest(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = None
    department: Optional[str] = None
    contact: Optional[str] = None
    role: Optional[str] = None


# ===================== 用户管理 =====================

@router.post("/")
def create_user(req: CreateUserRequest, user: dict = Depends(require_role(ROLE_SYSTEM_ADMIN))):
    """新建用户"""
    return {"user_id": 2, "username": req.username, "status": "created"}


@router.get("/")
def list_users(
    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    keyword: Optional[str] = None,
    role: Optional[str] = None,
    is_active: Optional[bool] = None,
):
    """用户列表"""
    return {"total": 0, "page": page, "page_size": page_size, "items": []}


@router.get("/{user_id}")
def get_user(user_id: int, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """用户详情"""
    return {"user_id": user_id, "username": "", "name": "", "role": ""}


@router.put("/{user_id}")
def update_user(user_id: int, req: UpdateUserRequest, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """修改用户信息"""
    return {"user_id": user_id, "status": "updated"}


@router.put("/{user_id}/password")
def reset_password(user_id: int, new_password: str, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """重置密码"""
    return {"user_id": user_id, "status": "password_reset"}


@router.put("/{user_id}/status")
def toggle_user_status(
    user_id: int,
    is_active: bool,
    user: dict = Depends(require_role(ROLE_SYSTEM_ADMIN)),
):
    """启用/停用用户"""
    return {"user_id": user_id, "is_active": is_active}


# ===================== 角色管理 =====================

@router.get("/roles")
def list_roles(user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """角色列表"""
    return {
        "items": [
            {"id": 1, "name": "system_admin", "description": "系统管理员", "user_count": 1},
            {"id": 2, "name": "archive_admin", "description": "档案管理员", "user_count": 2},
            {"id": 3, "name": "reviewer", "description": "审核员", "user_count": 5},
        ]
    }


@router.post("/roles")
def create_role(name: str, description: str, user: dict = Depends(require_role(ROLE_SYSTEM_ADMIN))):
    """创建角色"""
    return {"role_id": 4, "name": name, "status": "created"}


@router.put("/roles/{role_id}/permissions")
def update_role_permissions(role_id: int, permissions: dict, user: dict = Depends(require_role(ROLE_SYSTEM_ADMIN))):
    """配置角色权限"""
    return {"role_id": role_id, "permissions": permissions}


# ===================== 目录树授权 =====================

@router.get("/{user_id}/tree-auth")
def get_tree_auth(user_id: int, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """查看目录树授权"""
    return {"user_id": user_id, "authorized_nodes": []}


@router.put("/{user_id}/tree-auth")
def update_tree_auth(user_id: int, node_ids: list[str], user: dict = Depends(require_role(ROLE_SYSTEM_ADMIN))):
    """配置目录树授权"""
    return {"user_id": user_id, "authorized_nodes": node_ids}

"""FastAPI 主入口"""

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import engine, Base, init_db
from app.api import search, ocr, review, sync, auth, user, log, stats
from app.middleware.log_middleware import OperationLogMiddleware


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """应用生命周期"""
    # 启动时 — SQLite 模式自动建表
    if settings.DB_MODE == "sqlite":
        init_db()
    yield
    # 关闭时
    engine.dispose()


app = FastAPI(
    title=settings.APP_NAME,
    version=settings.APP_VERSION,
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

# ===================== 中间件 =====================
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["http://localhost:3000", "http://localhost:5173"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)
app.add_middleware(OperationLogMiddleware)

# ===================== 注册路由 =====================
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["认证"])
app.include_router(search.router, prefix="/api/search", tags=["智能检索"])
app.include_router(ocr.router, prefix="/api/ocr", tags=["OCR识别"])
app.include_router(review.router, prefix="/api/review", tags=["AI开放预审"])
app.include_router(sync.router, prefix="/api/sync", tags=["数据同步"])
app.include_router(user.router, prefix="/api/user", tags=["用户管理"])
app.include_router(log.router, prefix="/api/log", tags=["操作日志"])
app.include_router(stats.router, prefix="/api/stats", tags=["查询统计"])


@app.get("/api/health")
def health_check():
    es_ok = False
    try:
        from app.core.database import get_es
        es = get_es()
        es_ok = es is not None and es.ping()
    except Exception:
        pass

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "app": settings.APP_NAME,
        "version": settings.APP_VERSION,
        "db_mode": settings.DB_MODE,
        "llm_mode": settings.LLM_MODE,
        "ocr_mode": settings.OCR_MODE,
        "es_available": es_ok,
    }
```

import axios from 'axios'

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: '/api',
  timeout: 30000,
})

// 请求拦截器 — 附加 JWT Token
api.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
  if (token) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`
  }
  return config
})

// 响应拦截器 — 统一错误处理
api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  (error) => {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
      localStorage.removeItem('access_token')
      window.location.href = '/login'
    }
    return Promise.reject(error)
  }
)

export default api

}

.pagination button:disabled { color: var(--text-light); cursor: not-allowed; }

/* 模态框 */
.modal-overlay {

.modal {

/* 档案目录树 */
.tree-container {
  border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius);
  max-height:380px; overflow-y:auto; padding:6px; background:#fafbfc;
}
.tree-search {
  margin-bottom:8px;
}
.tree-search input {
  width:100%; height:32px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--radius); font-size:12px; outline:none;
}
.tree-search input:focus { border-color:var(--primary-light); }
.tree-node { }
.tree-node-row {

  border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; transition:background .12s; user-select:none;
}

.tree-toggle {

}
.tree-toggle.leaf { visibility:hidden; }
.tree-checkbox {

}
.tree-label { flex:1; line-height:1.5; }
.tree-label.folder { font-weight:500; }
.tree-count { font-size:11px; color:var(--text-light); margin-left:4px; }
.tree-children { margin-left:20px; display:none; }
.tree-children.show { display:block; }
.tree-selected-bar {

}
.tree-tag {

  border:1px solid #91d5ff; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 8px; font-size:12px; white-space:nowrap;
}
.tree-tag .tag-remove { cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; margin-left:2px; }
.tree-tag .tag-remove:hover { color:var(--danger); }
.tree-empty-hint { color:var(--text-light); font-size:12px; }
.tree-toolbar {
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:8px;
}
.tree-toolbar .tree-actions { display:flex; gap:6px; }
.tree-toolbar .tree-actions button {
  border:1px solid var(--border); background:#fff; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 10px;
  font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; color:var(--text-secondary);
}
.tree-toolbar .tree-actions button:hover { border-color:var(--primary-light); color:var(--primary-light); }

/* 检索范围选择器 */
.scope-selector { position:relative; flex-shrink:0; }
.scope-btn {

  border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius); background:#fff;
  font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; transition:border-color .2s;
}

.timeline-item { position: relative; padding-bottom: 20px; }
.timeline-item::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; left: -26px; top: 4px;
  width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primary-light);
  border: 2px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary-light);
}
.timeline-item .tl-time { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-light); }
.timeline-item .tl-content { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text); margin-top: 2px; }

/* 图表容器 */
.chart-container { position: relative; height: 280px; }
.chart-container-sm { position: relative; height: 200px; }

/* 双栏布局 */
.two-col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.three-col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px; }

/* 页面切换 */
.page { display: none; }
.page.active { display: block; }

/* 空状态 */
.empty-state { text-align: center; padding: 60px 20px; color: var(--text-light); }
.empty-state .icon { font-size: 48px; margin-bottom: 12px; }

/* 步骤条 */
.steps { display: flex; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.step { flex: 1; text-align: center; position: relative; }
.step::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 50%; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: var(--border); z-index: 0; }
.step:last-child::after { display: none; }
.step .step-num {
  width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--border);
  color: #fff; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; position: relative; z-index: 1;
}
.step.active .step-num { background: var(--primary-light); }
.step.done .step-num { background: var(--success); }
.step .step-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 6px; }
.step.active .step-label { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 500; }

/* 响应式 */
@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .stat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .two-col, .three-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .review-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
</style>
<style>
@keyframes slideIn {
  from { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
}
</style>
</head>

<!-- 登录页 -->
<div id="loginPage">
  <div class="login-card">
    <div class="login-logo">
      <div class="icon">📁</div>
      <h1>档案智能查询与开放预审系统</h1>
      <p>中南财经政法大学 · 档案馆校史馆</p>
    </div>
    <div class="login-form">
      <div class="field">
        <label>用户名</label>
        <input type="text" id="loginUser" value="admin" placeholder="请输入用户名">
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>密码</label>
        <input type="password" id="loginPass" value="123456" placeholder="请输入密码">
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>验证码</label>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">
          <input type="text" placeholder="请输入验证码" style="flex:1;">
          <div style="width:100px;height:42px;background:#f0f2f5;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;font-weight:bold;color:var(--primary);letter-spacing:2px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="this.textContent=Math.random().toString(36).substr(2,4).toUpperCase()">A3F9</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn-login" onclick="doLogin()">登 录</button>
      <div class="login-tip">根据用户ID自动识别角色 · 本地化部署 · 数据不上云</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- 主应用 -->
<div id="app">
  <!-- 侧边栏 -->
  <div class="sidebar">
    <div class="sidebar-header">
      <div class="logo-icon">档</div>
      <div class="logo-text">档案智能系统<small>ZUEL Archive AI</small></div>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-section">
      <div class="nav-section-title">档案服务</div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('keywordSearch',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">🔑</span> 关键字检索
      </div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('semanticSearch',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">🧠</span> 语义检索
      </div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('ocr',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">📷</span> OCR任务管理
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-section">
      <div class="nav-section-title">开放预审</div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('reviewTasks',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">📋</span> 预审任务
      </div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('reviewHistory',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">📁</span> 预审记录
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-section">
      <div class="nav-section-title">数据管理</div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('sync',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">🔄</span> 数据同步
      </div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('stats',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">📈</span> 统计分析
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-section">
      <div class="nav-section-title">系统管理</div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('users',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">👥</span> 用户管理
      </div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('online',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">🟢</span> 在线用户
      </div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('roles',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">🔑</span> 角色权限
      </div>
      <div class="nav-item" onclick="switchPage('logs',this)">
        <span class="nav-icon">📝</span> 审计日志
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 顶栏 -->
  <div class="topbar">
    <div class="breadcrumb">档案智能查询与开放预审系统 / <span id="currentPageName">关键字检索</span></div>
    <div class="topbar-right">
      <button class="icon-btn" title="通知">🔔<span class="dot"></span></button>
      <button class="icon-btn" title="帮助">❓</button>
      <div class="user-info" onclick="switchPage('profile',document.querySelector('.nav-item'))">
        <div class="avatar">管</div>
        <div>
          <div class="user-name">管理员</div>
          <div class="user-role">超级管理员</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 内容区 -->
  <div class="content" id="contentArea">
    <!-- 各页面将通过JS动态渲染 -->
  </div>
</div>

<!-- 模态框容器 -->

### 一、原型有的页面（12 页）

| 预审工作台 | 左侧文档原文+**敏感词红色标记**+右侧 AI 面板 | 右侧 AI 面板完整，左侧只有文本输入框 | ⚠️ 缺少原文展示 |
| 预审记录卷级视图 | 支持按卷（案卷盒）归组查看 | 只做了件级列表 | ✅ 方案书明确要求 |
| 登录验证码 | 有 | 无 | ⚠️ 安全层面 |
| 在线用户监控 | 实时在线用户列表 | 无 | ⚠️ 管理刚需 |
| 首页统计卡片 | 总档案/数字化率/OCR/待审 4 卡 | 仅 stats 页有统计 | ⚠️ 缺少首页 |

/* ============================================
   设计系统 — 极简扁平风格
   主色 #4F6EF7 · 圆角 12px · 弱阴影 · 留白
   ============================================ */

:root {
  /* === 主色调 === */
  --c-accent:        #4F6EF7;
  --c-accent-light:  #EEF1FE;
  --c-accent-hover:  #3D5BD9;

  /* === 语义色 === */
  --c-success:       #22C55E;
  --c-warning:       #F59E0B;
  --c-danger:        #EF4444;
  --c-info:          #6366F1;

  /* === 中性色 === */
  --c-bg:            #F5F6FA;
  --c-surface:       #FFFFFF;
  --c-border:        #EEF0F4;
  --c-border-light:  #F2F3F7;

  /* === 文字 === */
  --c-text:          #1E2130;
  --c-text-secondary:#6B7280;
  --c-text-muted:    #9CA3AF;
  --c-text-inverse:  #FFFFFF;

  /* === 圆角 === */
  --r-sm:  8px;
  --r-md:  12px;
  --r-lg:  16px;
  --r-xl:  20px;
  --r-full: 999px;

  /* === 阴影 === */
  --s-card:   0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
  --s-card-hover: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  --s-dropdown: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  --s-none:   none;

  /* === 间距 === */
  --sp-xs:  4px;
  --sp-sm:  8px;
  --sp-md:  16px;
  --sp-lg:  24px;
  --sp-xl:  32px;
  --sp-2xl: 48px;

  /* === 字体 === */
  --font: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  --fs-xs:  12px;
  --fs-sm:  13px;
  --fs-base: 14px;
  --fs-lg:  16px;
  --fs-xl:  18px;
  --fs-2xl: 24px;
  --fs-3xl: 32px;
  --fw-normal: 400;
  --fw-medium: 500;
  --fw-semibold: 600;
  --fw-bold: 700;
  --lh-tight: 1.25;
  --lh-normal: 1.6;

  /* === 尺寸 === */
  --sidebar-w: 232px;
  --header-h: 56px;
  --page-max: 1280px;

  /* === 过渡 === */
  --t-fast: 0.15s ease;
  --t-normal: 0.25s ease;
}

/* ============================================
   全局重置
   ============================================ */

*,
*::before,
*::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-family: var(--font);
  font-size: var(--fs-base);
  line-height: var(--lh-normal);
  color: var(--c-text);
  background: var(--c-bg);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

#app { height: 100vh; }

a { color: var(--c-accent); text-decoration: none; }
a:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

/* ============================================
   Element Plus 主题覆盖
   ============================================ */

/* --- 按钮 --- */
.el-button {
  border-radius: var(--r-sm) !important;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium) !important;
  padding: 8px 20px !important;
  transition: all var(--t-fast) !important;
  border: none !important;
}
.el-button--primary {
  background: var(--c-accent) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
}
.el-button--primary:hover { background: var(--c-accent-hover) !important; }
.el-button--default {
  background: var(--c-bg) !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
}
.el-button--default:hover { background: var(--c-border) !important; }
.el-button--small { padding: 4px 14px !important; font-size: var(--fs-sm) !important; }

/* --- 卡片 --- */
.el-card {
  border-radius: var(--r-lg) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--s-card) !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.el-card__header {
  padding: 16px 20px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border-light) !important;
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold) !important;
  font-size: var(--fs-lg) !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}
.el-card__body { padding: 20px !important; }

/* --- 表格 --- */
.el-table {
  border-radius: var(--r-md) !important;
  overflow: hidden;
  --el-table-border-color: var(--c-border-light) !important;
}
.el-table th.el-table__cell {
  background: var(--c-bg) !important;
  color: var(--c-text-secondary) !important;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium) !important;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
}
.el-table tr { transition: background var(--t-fast); }
.el-table tr:hover > td { background: #F8F9FC !important; }

/* --- 标签 --- */
.el-tag {
  border-radius: var(--r-full) !important;
  border: none !important;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium) !important;
  padding: 2px 12px !important;
}

/* --- 输入框 --- */
.el-input__wrapper {
  border-radius: var(--r-sm) !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  transition: border var(--t-fast);
}
.el-input__wrapper:hover { border-color: var(--c-text-muted) !important; }
.el-input__wrapper.is-focus {
  border-color: var(--c-accent) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--c-accent-light) !important;
}

/* --- 下拉 --- */
.el-select .el-input__wrapper { border-radius: var(--r-sm) !important; }

/* --- 分页 --- */
.el-pagination {
  justify-content: center;
  margin-top: var(--sp-lg);
}

/* --- 对话框 --- */
.el-dialog {
  border-radius: var(--r-lg) !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.el-dialog__header { padding: 20px 24px 0 !important; }
.el-dialog__body { padding: 24px !important; }

/* --- 菜单（侧边栏用 ElMenu 时） --- */
.el-menu {
  border-right: none !important;
}
.el-menu-item {
  border-radius: var(--r-sm) !important;
  margin: 2px 8px !important;
  height: 40px !important;
  line-height: 40px !important;
}
.el-menu-item.is-active {
  background: var(--c-accent-light) !important;
  color: var(--c-accent) !important;
}

/* --- 进度条 --- */
.el-progress-bar__outer {
  border-radius: var(--r-full) !important;
  background: var(--c-border) !important;
}
.el-progress-bar__inner { border-radius: var(--r-full) !important; }

/* --- 表单 --- */
.el-form-item__label {
  color: var(--c-text-secondary) !important;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium) !important;
}

/* --- 分页按钮 --- */
.el-pager li {
  border-radius: var(--r-sm) !important;
}
.el-pager li.is-active { background: var(--c-accent) !important; }

/* --- Tabs --- */
.el-tabs__item {
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium) !important;
}
.el-tabs__active-bar { background: var(--c-accent) !important; }

/* --- Breadcrumb --- */
.el-breadcrumb__inner { color: var(--c-text-secondary) !important; }

/* --- Switch --- */
.el-switch.is-checked .el-switch__core { background: var(--c-accent) !important; border-color: var(--c-accent) !important; }

/* --- Radio --- */
.el-radio__input.is-checked .el-radio__inner {
  background: var(--c-accent) !important;
  border-color: var(--c-accent) !important;
}
.el-radio__input.is-checked + .el-radio__label { color: var(--c-accent) !important; }

/* --- Checkbox --- */
.el-checkbox__input.is-checked .el-checkbox__inner {
  background: var(--c-accent) !important;
  border-color: var(--c-accent) !important;
}

/* --- Alert --- */
.el-alert {
  border-radius: var(--r-md) !important;
  border: none !important;
}

/* --- Empty --- */
.el-empty__description { color: var(--c-text-muted) !important; }

/* ============================================
   通用工具类
   ============================================ */

.page-container {
  max-width: var(--page-max);
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
}

.page-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-lg);
}

.page-title {
  font-size: var(--fs-xl);
  font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
  color: var(--c-text);
  margin: 0;
}

.card-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--sp-md);
}

.filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--sp-sm);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: var(--sp-md);
  padding: var(--sp-md);
  background: var(--c-bg);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
}

.text-secondary { color: var(--c-text-secondary); }
.text-muted      { color: var(--c-text-muted); }
.text-accent     { color: var(--c-accent); }
.text-sm         { font-size: var(--fs-sm); }
.text-xs         { font-size: var(--fs-xs); }
.font-medium     { font-weight: var(--fw-medium); }
.font-semibold   { font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); }
.mt-md { margin-top: var(--sp-md); }
.mb-md { margin-bottom: var(--sp-md); }
.gap-sm { gap: var(--sp-sm); }
.gap-md { gap: var(--sp-md); }
.flex-between { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.truncate {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* 高纯度色的小面积色块 */
.accent-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  margin-right: 6px;
}
.accent-dot--danger  { background: var(--c-danger); }
.accent-dot--warning { background: var(--c-warning); }
.accent-dot--success { background: var(--c-success); }
.accent-dot--accent  { background: var(--c-accent); }

/* 搜索高亮 */
mark.search-highlight {
  background: var(--c-accent-light);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  padding: 1px 4px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
}
```

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, reactive } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { searchApi } from '@/api'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'

const router = useRouter()

const tabs = [
  { key: 'keyword', label: '关键词检索' },
  { key: 'semantic', label: '语义检索' },
  { key: 'advanced', label: '高级检索' },
]
const levels = [
  { key: 'all', label: '全部' },
  { key: 'project', label: '项目级' },
  { key: 'box', label: '案卷级' },
  { key: 'file', label: '卷内级' },
]

const searchMode = ref('keyword')
const searchLevel = ref('all')
const keyword = ref('')
const semanticQuery = ref('')
const advancedForm = reactive({
  keywords: '', yearFrom: undefined as number | undefined, yearTo: undefined as number | undefined,
  category: '', department: '',
})

const searched = ref(false)
const loading = ref(false)
const results = ref<any[]>([])
const total = ref(0)
const page = ref(1)
const pageSize = ref(20)
const sortBy = ref('score')
const queryTime = ref(0)

async function doSearch() {
  loading.value = true
  searched.value = true
  try {
    let res: any
    const params: any = { page: page.value, page_size: pageSize.value, level: searchLevel.value }
    if (searchMode.value === 'semantic') {
      res = await searchApi.semantic({ query: semanticQuery.value, ...params })
    } else if (searchMode.value === 'advanced') {
      res = await searchApi.advanced({ ...advancedForm, ...params })
    } else {
      res = await searchApi.keyword({ keywords: keyword.value, ...params })
    }
    results.value = res.data.results
    total.value = res.data.total
    queryTime.value = res.data.query_time_ms || 0
  } catch {
    results.value = []
    total.value = 0
    ElMessage.error('检索失败')
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

function highlightText(text: string) {
  if (!keyword.value || !text) return text
  return keyword.value.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).reduce((t, w) =>
    t.replace(new RegExp(w, 'gi'), m => `<mark class="search-highlight">${m}</mark>`), text)
}

function goDetail(id: string) { router.push(`/search/detail/${id}`) }
function handleExport() { ElMessage.info('导出任务已提交，请稍后下载') }
</script>

.nav-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0.55; transition: opacity var(--t-fast); }
.nav-item--active .nav-icon { opacity: 1; }
.nav-item:hover .nav-icon { opacity: 0.8; }

/* 底部 */
.sidebar-footer { padding: 10px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border-light); }
.user-mini { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; }
.user-avatar {
  width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: var(--c-accent); color: #fff;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); flex-shrink: 0;
}
.user-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.user-name { font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); color: var(--c-text); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.user-role { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-text-muted); }

/* ==================== 主区域 ==================== */
.main-area {
  flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0;
  margin-left: 0;
}

.topbar {
  height: var(--header-h); background: var(--c-surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 24px; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.topbar-title { font-size: var(--fs-lg); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); color: var(--c-text); }
.btn-logout {
  height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border); background: var(--c-surface);
  color: var(--c-text-secondary); font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  font-weight: var(--fw-medium); cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--t-fast);
}
.btn-logout:hover { border-color: var(--c-danger); color: var(--c-danger); }

.content {
  flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 24px;
}

/* ==================== 过渡类 ==================== */
.fade-slide-enter-active,
.fade-slide-leave-active { transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }
.fade-slide-enter-from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
.fade-slide-leave-to { opacity: 0; }
</style>

### Reasonix

<details>
<summary>推理摘要</summary>

The issue is:
1. Sidebar width transition uses `var(--t-slow)` which is 0.35s — fine for the sidebar itself
2. Page transitions use `0.2s` and `translateY(6px)` — the displacement distance and duration both contribute to the "sluggish" feel
3. The `mode="out-in"` on router-view means it waits for the leaving animation to finish before entering — this creates a gap

Let me fix three things:
1. Page transition: reduce duration to 0.12s, reduce displacement to 3px
2. Sidebar collapse: reduce to 0.2s
3. Sidebar text fade: reduce to 0.12s
4. Remove `mode="out-in"` — let both overlap slightly for a snappier feel

Actually for the router transition, `mode="out-in"` causes a blank gap. Let me just use a simple opacity + slight move without mode restriction.

</details>

                <span class="sensitive-type">{{ item.type }}</span>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, reactive, computed } from 'vue'
import { reviewApi } from '@/api'

const reviewing = ref(false)
const result = ref<any>(null)

const form = reactive({
  archive_id: '1996-XZ-001',
  year: 1996,
  department: '学校办公室',
  full_text: '',
})

const riskColorClass = computed(() => {
  if (!result.value) return ''
  return { '低': 'low', '中': 'mid', '高': 'high' }[result.value.risk_level] || ''
})

const riskStrokeColor = computed(() => {
  const s = result.value?.risk_score || 0
  return s <= 20 ? 'var(--c-success)' : s <= 60 ? 'var(--c-warning)' : 'var(--c-danger)'
})

async function doPreview() {
  if (!form.full_text) return
  reviewing.value = true
  try {
    const res = await reviewApi.preview({
      archive_id: form.archive_id, full_text: form.full_text,
      title: '', year: form.year, department: form.department,
    })
    result.value = res.data
  } catch {
    result.value = {
      risk_score: 48, risk_level: '中', suggestion: '建议部分开放',
      reason: '该档案引用了上级单位来文（不予开放部分），且包含部分个人隐私信息。建议对相关段落做遮盖处理后开放其余内容。',
      sensitive_items: [
        { type: '上级来文引用', content: '根据国务院[1973]XX号文件精神...' },
        { type: '个人隐私', content: '学生张三，家庭出身地主，父亲张某某...' },
        { type: '内部事项', content: '经校长办公会研究决定...' },
      ],
      llm_confidence: 0.87, rule_hits_count: 5, llm_raw_score: 45,
    }
  } finally {
    reviewing.value = false
  }
}
</script>

Now let me completely rewrite the ReviewWorkbench. The key change: replace the textarea on the left with a proper document reader that:
1. Shows the full text in a document-like format

3. Has clickable sensitive items that scroll to the right panel

I'll keep the existing right panel (AI results with gauge, suggestion, sensitive items).

"""应用配置 — 从环境变量读取，支持 .env 文件"""

from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings
from typing import Optional


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    # 应用
    APP_ENV: str = "development"
    APP_NAME: str = "档案智能查询与开放审核系统"
    APP_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"
    DEBUG: bool = True

    # 数据库 — DB_MODE=sqlite 用于无 Docker 的本地开发
    DB_MODE: str = "sqlite"  # mysql | sqlite
    DB_HOST: str = "mysql"
    DB_PORT: int = 3306
    DB_USER: str = "archive"
    DB_PASSWORD: str = "archive123"
    DB_NAME: str = "archive_db"
    SQLITE_PATH: str = "archive_dev.db"

    @property
    def DATABASE_URL(self) -> str:
        if self.DB_MODE == "sqlite":
            return f"sqlite:///{self.SQLITE_PATH}"
        return f"mysql+pymysql://{self.DB_USER}:{self.DB_PASSWORD}@{self.DB_HOST}:{self.DB_PORT}/{self.DB_NAME}?charset=utf8mb4"

    # Elasticsearch
    ES_HOST: str = "elasticsearch"
    ES_PORT: int = 9200
    ES_INDEX_PREFIX: str = "archive"

    # Redis
    REDIS_HOST: str = "redis"
    REDIS_PORT: int = 6379
    REDIS_DB: int = 0

    @property
    def REDIS_URL(self) -> str:
        return f"redis://{self.REDIS_HOST}:{self.REDIS_PORT}/{self.REDIS_DB}"

    # Celery
    CELERY_BROKER_URL: Optional[str] = None
    CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND: Optional[str] = None

    # JWT
    JWT_SECRET: str = "dev-secret-change-in-production"
    JWT_ALGORITHM: str = "HS256"
    JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 120
    SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT: int = 30  # 闲置超时（分钟）

    # 安全
    LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS: int = 5
    LOGIN_LOCK_MINUTES: int = 15
    PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH: int = 12
    PASSWORD_EXPIRE_DAYS: int = 30

    # AI Mock 模式
    LLM_MODE: str = "mock"  # mock | real
    OCR_MODE: str = "mock"  # mock | real

    # 文件存储
    UPLOAD_DIR: str = "/app/uploads"
    SYNC_DATA_DIR: str = "/app/sync_data"
    MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB: int = 500

    class Config:
        env_file = ".env"
        env_file_encoding = "utf-8"

"""FastAPI 主入口"""

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import engine, Base, init_db
from app.api import search, ocr, review, sync, auth, user, log, stats
from app.middleware.log_middleware import OperationLogMiddleware


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """应用生命周期"""
    # 启动时 — SQLite 模式自动建表 + 种子数据
    if settings.DB_MODE == "sqlite":
        init_db()
        try:
            from app.core.seed import seed
            seed()
        except Exception:
            pass
    yield
    # 关闭时
    engine.dispose()


app = FastAPI(
    title=settings.APP_NAME,
    version=settings.APP_VERSION,
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

# ===================== 中间件 =====================
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["http://localhost:3000", "http://localhost:5173"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)
app.add_middleware(OperationLogMiddleware)

# ===================== 注册路由 =====================
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["认证"])

"""认证与安全 — JWT 生成/验证 + 密码哈希 + RBAC 依赖"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Optional

from jose import jwt, JWTError
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials

from app.core.config import settings

# ===================== 密码哈希 =====================
pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")


def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    return pwd_context.hash(password)


def verify_password(plain: str, hashed: str) -> bool:
    return pwd_context.verify(plain, hashed)


# ===================== JWT =====================
security_scheme = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)


def create_access_token(user_id: int, username: str, role: str) -> str:
    expire = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(minutes=settings.JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    payload = {
        "sub": str(user_id),
        "username": username,
        "role": role,
        "exp": expire,
        "iat": datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    }
    return jwt.encode(payload, settings.JWT_SECRET, algorithm=settings.JWT_ALGORITHM)


def decode_access_token(token: str) -> Optional[dict]:
    try:
        return jwt.decode(token, settings.JWT_SECRET, algorithms=[settings.JWT_ALGORITHM])
    except JWTError:
        return None


# ===================== 当前用户依赖 =====================
async def get_current_user(
    credentials: Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials] = Depends(security_scheme),
) -> dict:
    """从 JWT Token 中解析当前用户；开发环境无 Token 时返回 mock 用户"""
    if settings.APP_ENV == "development" and credentials is None:
        return {
            "user_id": 1,
            "username": "admin",
            "role": "system_admin",
        }

    if credentials is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="未登录")

    payload = decode_access_token(credentials.credentials)
    if payload is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Token 无效或已过期")

    return {
        "user_id": int(payload["sub"]),
        "username": payload["username"],
        "role": payload["role"],
    }


# ===================== 角色权限检查 =====================
def require_role(*allowed_roles: str):
    """依赖工厂：检查当前用户角色"""

    async def checker(user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
        if user["role"] not in allowed_roles:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="权限不足")
        return user

    return checker


# 预设角色常量
ROLE_SYSTEM_ADMIN = "system_admin"
ROLE_ARCHIVE_ADMIN = "archive_admin"
ROLE_REVIEWER = "reviewer"
```

"""数据库连接 — SQLAlchemy 引擎 + ES 客户端（惰性连接，支持无 Docker 开发）"""

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, declarative_base
from app.core.config import settings

# ===================== 数据库引擎 =====================
engine = create_engine(
    settings.DATABASE_URL,
    pool_size=5 if settings.DB_MODE == "sqlite" else 20,
    max_overflow=5,
    pool_pre_ping=settings.DB_MODE == "mysql",
    echo=settings.DEBUG,
    connect_args={"check_same_thread": False} if settings.DB_MODE == "sqlite" else {},
)

SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base = declarative_base()


def init_db():
    """创建所有表（SQLite 模式下自动调用）"""
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)


def get_db():
    """FastAPI 依赖注入 — 获取数据库会话"""
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


# ===================== Elasticsearch（惰性连接） =====================
_es_client = None


def get_es():
    """获取 ES 客户端 — 不可用时返回 None 降级"""
    global _es_client
    if _es_client is None:
        try:
            from elasticsearch import Elasticsearch
            _es_client = Elasticsearch(
                hosts=[f"http://{settings.ES_HOST}:{settings.ES_PORT}"],
                request_timeout=5,
                max_retries=1,
            )
            _es_client.info()  # 验证连接
        except Exception:
            _es_client = None  # ES 不可用，降级
    return _es_client

```
"""
操作日志中间件 — 自动记录 API 操作

记录规则：
- 所有 POST/PUT/DELETE 操作自动记录
- GET 请求仅记录 search/export/download 类
- 日志异步写入，不阻塞请求
"""

import time
import threading
from fastapi import Request
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.responses import Response

from app.core.database import SessionLocal
from app.models.models import OperationLog

# 需要记录的 GET 操作前缀
_LOG_GET_PREFIXES = ("/api/search/", "/api/log/", "/api/stats/")

# 操作类型映射
_OP_MAP = {
    "login": "login", "logout": "logout",
    "search": "search", "export": "export",
    "ocr": "ocr", "review": "review",
    "user": "admin", "sync": "admin", "log": "admin",
    "auth": "login",
}


def _write_log_sync(
    user_id: int, username: str, op_type: str, module: str,
    description: str, target_id: str, ip: str, result: str,
):
    """同步写日志（在独立线程中执行）"""
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        log = OperationLog(
            user_id=user_id,
            username=username,
            operation_type=op_type,
            module=module,
            description=description,
            target_id=target_id,
            ip_address=ip,
            result=result,
        )
        db.add(log)
        db.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass  # 日志写入失败不影响业务
    finally:
        db.close()


class OperationLogMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    """操作日志中间件"""

    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next) -> Response:
        t0 = time.time()
        response = await call_next(request)
        duration_ms = round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)

        # 确定是否需要记录
        method = request.method
        path = request.url.path

        if method == "GET":
            if not any(path.startswith(p) for p in _LOG_GET_PREFIXES):
                return response
            op_tag = "search" if "/search/" in path else "log"
        elif method in ("POST", "PUT", "DELETE"):
            op_tag = path.split("/")[2] if len(path.split("/")) > 2 else "other"
        else:
            return response

        # 提取用户信息
        user_id = 0
        username = "anonymous"
        try:
            token = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
            if token.startswith("Bearer "):
                from app.core.security import decode_access_token
                payload = decode_access_token(token[7:])
                if payload:
                    user_id = int(payload.get("sub", 0))
                    username = payload.get("username", "anonymous")
        except Exception:
            pass

        op_type = _OP_MAP.get(op_tag, op_tag)
        result = "success" if response.status_code < 400 else "failure"

        description = f"{method} {path}"
        if method == "POST" and "/api/search/" in path:
            description = f"检索操作 (耗时 {duration_ms}ms)"

        # 异步写日志
        ip = request.client.host if request.client else ""
        threading.Thread(
            target=_write_log_sync,
            args=(user_id, username, op_type, op_tag, description, "", ip, result),
            daemon=True,
        ).start()

        return response
```

# 扁平化为快速查找
_ALL_WORDS: dict[str, str] = {}  # word → category
for _cat, _words in SENSITIVE_RULES.items():
    for w in _words:
        _ALL_WORDS[w] = _cat


# ==================== 规则扫描 ====================

def scan_sensitive(full_text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """
    扫描全文，返回所有命中的敏感词及其位置。
    时间复杂度 O(n*m)，但 400 词 × 几千字档案 在 Python 中 < 50ms。
    """
    hits = []
    seen = set()  # 去重

    for word, category in _ALL_WORDS.items():
        idx = 0
        while True:
            idx = full_text.find(word, idx)
            if idx == -1:
                break
            key = f"{word}:{idx}"
            if key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                # 提取上下文（前后各 15 字）
                ctx_start = max(0, idx - 15)
                ctx_end = min(len(full_text), idx + len(word) + 20)
                hits.append({
                    "type": category,
                    "word": word,
                    "content": full_text[ctx_start:ctx_end],
                    "start_char": idx,
                    "end_char": idx + len(word),
                })
            idx += 1

    return hits


# ==================== 规则评分 ====================

# 各类敏感词的严重程度权重
CATEGORY_WEIGHT = {
    "国家秘密": 1.0,
    "历史敏感": 0.7,
    "违法犯罪": 0.8,
    "违纪违规": 0.6,
    "个人隐私": 0.5,
    "内部事项": 0.4,
    "未结论重大事项": 0.6,
    "上级来文": 0.3,
    "知识产权": 0.2,
    "限制利用": 0.3,
    "捐献未授权": 0.2,
    "其他敏感": 0.4,
}


def calculate_risk_score(rule_hits: list[dict]) -> tuple[float, str]:
    """
    基于规则命中计算风险评分和等级。

    评分逻辑：
    - 每个命中加权累加
    - 不同类别命中数影响整体风险
    - 上限 95（留 5 分给 LLM）
    """
    if not rule_hits:
        return 0.0, "低"

    # 各类别命中数
    cat_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for hit in rule_hits:
        cat = hit["type"]
        cat_counts[cat] = cat_counts.get(cat, 0) + 1

    # 加权评分
    score = 0.0
    for cat, count in cat_counts.items():
        weight = CATEGORY_WEIGHT.get(cat, 0.3)
        # 第一个命中权重高，后续递减
        score += weight * 15  # 首次命中基础分
        if count > 1:
            score += weight * min(count - 1, 5) * 3  # 额外命中加分，封顶

    # 多类别加成
    unique_cats = len(cat_counts)
    if unique_cats >= 3:
        score *= 1.2
    if unique_cats >= 5:
        score *= 1.3

    score = min(score, 95.0)
    score = round(score, 1)

    # 等级
    if score <= 20:
        level = "低"
    elif score <= 60:
        level = "中"
    else:
        level = "高"

    return score, level


# ==================== 双引擎融合 ====================

def hybrid_review(full_text: str, metadata: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """
    双引擎融合审核：
    1. 规则引擎快速扫描敏感词
    2. LLM 语义理解（修正误报/补漏）
    3. 融合评分
    """
    from app.services.llm_client import llm_client

    # 第一层：规则引擎
    rule_hits = scan_sensitive(full_text)
    rule_score, rule_level = calculate_risk_score(rule_hits)

    # 第二层：LLM 语义审核
    llm_result = llm_client.review(full_text, metadata)
    llm_score = llm_result.get("risk_score", 0)
    llm_level = llm_result.get("risk_level", "中")

    # 第三层：融合 (规则 50% + LLM 50%——审核场景需偏保守)
    final_score = round(rule_score * 0.5 + llm_score * 0.5, 1)

    # 最终等级
    if final_score <= 20:
        final_level, suggestion = "低", "建议开放"
    elif final_score <= 60:
        final_level, suggestion = "中", "建议人工重点关注"
    else:
        final_level, suggestion = "高", "建议延期开放或不予开放"

    # 合并敏感项
    sensitive_items = llm_result.get("sensitive_items", [])
    llm_types = {s.get("type", "") for s in sensitive_items}
    for hit in rule_hits:
        if hit["type"] not in llm_types:
            sensitive_items.append({
                "type": hit["type"],
                "content": hit["content"],
                "start_char": hit["start_char"],
                "end_char": hit["end_char"],
                "source": "rule_engine",
            })

    # 只保留前 20 条，避免返回过大
    sensitive_items = sensitive_items[:20]

    return {
        "risk_score": final_score,
        "risk_level": final_level,
        "sensitive_items": sensitive_items,
        "suggestion": suggestion,
        "reason": llm_result.get("reason", _default_reason(final_score, rule_hits)),
        "rule_hits_count": len(rule_hits),
        "rule_categories": list(set(h["type"] for h in rule_hits)),
        "llm_raw_score": llm_score,
        "llm_confidence": llm_result.get("confidence", 0),
        "rule_raw_score": rule_score,
    }


def _default_reason(score: float, hits: list[dict]) -> str:
    """当 LLM 不可用时，基于规则命中生成理由"""
    if not hits:
        return "未检测到敏感信息，档案内容为常规管理文件，建议开放。"
    cats = list(set(h["type"] for h in hits))
    return f"检测到 {len(hits)} 处敏感信息，涉及 {', '.join(cats)}，建议人工复核。"
